title: ABG: acid–base reading

findings.where: Step "limits", metabolic-alkalosis narration; corresponding formula in images 7 and 15
findings.title: Spoken formula omits the parentheses
findings.problem: "Forty plus point seven times the bicarbonate minus twenty-four" can be understood as 40 + 0.7 × HCO₃⁻ − 24, rather than 40 + 0.7 × (HCO₃⁻ − 24). With HCO₃⁻ 36, those give 41.2 versus 48.4 mmHg—enough to change the compensation interpretation. The displayed equation is correct; the script is ambiguous.
findings.fix: Say: "Forty plus zero point seven times the quantity bicarbonate minus twenty-four." Preserve that grouping in the recorded audio.

findings.where: Gauge() normal-range bands, especially dark-theme images 9–12 and 16; kit.jsx gradient and sheen
findings.title: Normal-range bands lack sufficient contrast
findings.problem: The normal band uses translucent teal plus a card-colored sheen without a contrasting outline. In dark mode, even its strongest portion is approximately 3.8:1 against the track, while parts fall below 3:1. It therefore misses the project's 4.5:1 target and makes the normal interval harder to locate for low-vision students. The readable endpoint numbers do not make the band itself distinguishable.
findings.fix: Add a solid, high-contrast boundary using the existing accent-ink token, or another non-color-only treatment. Keep the gradient decorative and verify the band boundaries against adjacent fills in both themes.

assessment: Needs revision: the narration loses essential mathematical grouping, and the normal-range graphics fail the specified contrast target.
